name: Baccaurea macrocarpa
tagline: A rare tropical rainforest fruit tree valued for its nutritious and medicinal fruit.
description: Baccaurea macrocarpa, commonly known as Tampoi, is a tropical fruit tree native to Southeast Asia. It is widely found in regions of Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. The tree produces edible antioxidant-rich fruits that are appreciated for their sweet and slightly tangy taste. Traditionally, different parts of the plant have been used in folk medicine for digestive support and for minor skin-related conditions.
origin: Tropical Southeast Asia, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand
medical: Antioxidant-rich, digestive aid, anti-inflammatory properties. Folk medicine reports topical use for minor swelling or skin issues.

name: Morus nigra
tagline: A nutrient-rich mulberry tree valued for its sweet fruits and traditional medicinal benefits.
description: Morus nigra, commonly known as Brazilian Mulberry or Black Mulberry, is a fruit-bearing tree originally native to Western Asia, especially Persia. The tree produces dark, sweet berries that are rich in Vitamin C, minerals, dietary fiber, and water content, making them nutritious and refreshing. Traditionally, different parts of the plant, especially the leaves, have been valued for their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and digestive-supporting properties.
medical: Rich in Vitamin C, minerals, dietary fiber, and water content with low calories and moderate sugar. Contains phytochemicals with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Leaf compounds may help inhibit digestive enzymes.

name: Dimocarpus didyma
tagline: A rare tropical fruit tree known for its lychee-like fruits and antioxidant-rich nutritional value.
description: Dimocarpus didyma, commonly known as Wild Lychee, is a tropical fruit tree native to regions of the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia. The tree produces edible fruits similar to lychee and is valued for its nutritional richness and traditional significance. The fruits contain Vitamin C, potassium, copper, and antioxidant compounds that help support overall health and wellness.
medical: Rich in Vitamin C, potassium, copper, and antioxidants such as epicatechin and rutin. These compounds support immune health, cardiovascular protection, and antioxidant defense.

name: Garcinia mangostana var. Mesta
tagline: A premium mangosteen variety celebrated for its rich flavor and powerful antioxidant properties.
description: Garcinia mangostana var. Mesta, commonly known as Mangosteen, is a highly valued tropical fruit variety originating from Southeast Asia, particularly Malaysia. Known for its sweet, juicy flesh and deep purple rind, this fruit is prized for both its taste and medicinal significance. It contains rich bioactive compounds and antioxidants that support overall wellness and traditional health practices.
medical: Rich in xanthones with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activity. Contains bioactive compounds beneficial for immune support, cardiovascular health, and metabolic regulation.

name: Ziziphus mauritiana
tagline: A hardy and nutritious fruit tree valued for its refreshing fruits and traditional medicinal uses.
description: Ziziphus mauritiana, commonly known as Red Ber Apple, is a tropical fruit tree widely cultivated across South Asia, especially in India, Pakistan, and Southeast Asia. The tree produces sweet and tangy fruits that are enjoyed fresh and valued for their nutritional richness. Traditionally, the fruit has been appreciated for supporting digestion, immunity, and overall wellness through its natural vitamins and antioxidants.
origin: South Asia, especially India, Pakistan, Southeast Asia
medical: A good source of Vitamin C, dietary fiber, and antioxidants. Traditionally associated with anti-inflammatory properties, digestive support, and strengthening immune function.

name: Mangifera indica
tagline: A traditional mango variety cherished for its rich flavor, nutrition, and cultural significance.
description: Mangifera indica, commonly known as Kolambu Mango, is a traditional mango variety associated with the Jaffna region of Sri Lanka and parts of Kerala. The fruit is appreciated for its delicious taste, aromatic quality, and nutritional richness. It contains essential vitamins, minerals, fiber, and antioxidants that contribute to overall wellness and traditional dietary practices.
medical: Rich in Vitamins A and C, dietary fiber, minerals, and antioxidants. Traditionally associated with digestive support and maintaining healthy blood pressure.
